units.source_text: 在这个村子的十几个低级饭馆的女招待中，唯独阿笑特别有伤风化，当地派出所的警察曾多次勒令她离开这个村子。

en.t: Among the waitresses at the dozen or so low-class restaurants in this village, only O-Ei was considered especially indecent, and the police at the local station had repeatedly ordered her to leave the village.

units.source_text: 因为村议会议员的儿子之流同她来往频繁。

en.t: This was because people like the sons of village council members were constantly associating with her.

units.source_text: 她是天生的女招待，太风骚了。

en.t: She was a born waitress, far too flirtatious by nature.
